title: The Chamber Where Stone Learns to Flow Backward

features.name: the primary flow reversal chip
features.desc-on-touch: A black IC block studded with pin dots, humming with current that flows backward through time. Stone has become circuit; causality has become negotiable.

features.name: the temporal argument node
features.desc-on-touch: Where two pathways meet, stone and water debate which direction is forward. The debate produces heat. Neither will yield.

features.name: the sediment cascade stack
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of stone compressed into a tower, each stratum reading the one beneath it in reverse. Time settles downward. Time rises back up as questions.

features.name: the underground river's broadcast
features.desc-on-touch: You hear water flowing upward through the circuit. The sound has no beginning, only endings working backward toward their sources.

features.name: the recursive feedback loop
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe box containing its own reflection, which contains another box, which contains the first one still unfamiliar to itself. The geometry refuses to settle.

inscription: here stone learned that flowing backwards is just being patient in the other direction

file.name: Cavern_Seismic_Trace_Reversed_TimeDomain.wav
file.note: Seismic recording from a deep karst cavity played backward and forward simultaneously. The stone speaks in both directions. Checksum: emotionally valid / formally unstable.
